immutable_failure_reproduction.observed_failure: active paper snapshot is outside 24h for 2330.TW: event_time=2026-08-28T05:30:00Z age_seconds>86400
immutable_failure_reproduction.root_cause: A fixed 24h max-age check compared now (Saturday) against the latest official Friday TWSE/TPEx close, which cannot have a newer official close until the next trading session, so the deploy readback gate and Agora operational readiness both fail-closed on a market condition (weekend) rather than a real staleness or lineage defect.

diagnosis.cause: market_snapshot_admission.admit_market_snapshot, the deploy script's inline readback check, and services/control-plane/bff/agora/operational_readiness.py each compared age_seconds against a flat max_age_seconds/sla_seconds with no notion of Asia/Taipei trading sessions, weekends, or official market holidays.
constraints_preserved: Non-Taiwan symbols keep the unchanged flat max_age_seconds behavior in admit_market_snapshot and operational_readiness.
Weekday staleness (a later official session already closed), a stale refresh receipt, non-official lineage, and future event/observation times remain fail-closed with typed reason codes.
No new provider egress, fixture data, or bypass of the minimum-closes / lineage checks.

shared_rule.rule: A Taiwan official close is admitted when the gap between its event_time and now is fully explained by weekends and/or governed OFFICIAL_TW_MARKET_HOLIDAYS entries (each citing an announcing authority), and the refresh receipt (observed_at) is within max_refresh_age_seconds of now, and the lineage carries an official tw-official:/tw-twse-tpex-official-market marker. Any weekday in the gap with no evidence is treated as an ordinary trading day (fail-closed stale); a lookup that raises or returns the CALENDAR_EVIDENCE_UNVERIFIABLE sentinel fails closed as unverifiable instead of silently guessing.

call_sites.change: none required; it already calls the shared admit_market_snapshot, which now internally routes Taiwan symbols through evaluate_taiwan_market_freshness.
none required; _check_market_admission already delegates to the shared admit_market_snapshot.

_evaluate_source now imports evaluate_taiwan_market_freshness/is_taiwan_symbol/parse_rfc3339 from market_snapshot_admission and routes Taiwan-symbol snapshots through the same rule instead of the flat age_seconds > sla_seconds comparison; non-Taiwan snapshots are unchanged.

verify_bounded_source_refresh_readback's inline Python readback check imports evaluate_taiwan_market_freshness/is_taiwan_symbol and replaces the flat 'outside 24h' SystemExit for Taiwan symbols with the shared rule; the future-time (-300s) guard and the official-lineage check are unchanged.

new_deterministic_taiwan_scenarios: Friday close admitted on Saturday (weekend gap, no calendar evidence needed).
Multi-day official Lunar New Year holiday span admitted with governed calendar evidence.

Stale refresh receipt (observed_at older than max_refresh_age_seconds) rejected as market_input_stale_refresh.
Unverifiable calendar evidence (lookup sentinel) rejected as market_input_calendar_unverifiable.
Non-Taiwan symbol (AAPL.US) with an identical multi-day gap keeps the unchanged flat max_age_seconds stale rejection.
